key_assessments.origin: origin/main (the one key main added; not audited by this PR's earlier rounds)
key_assessments.en: The saved copy is gone too.
key_assessments.reasoning: Read against its context note (under 'Moved or deleted' on a sent file card, stating the second loss) and against the sibling strings. 'Tampoco' correctly presupposes the first loss stated by 'Movido o eliminado', and 'queda' carries 'is gone' without implying a recovery action, matching the row's lack of a copy control. 'la copia guardada' reuses saved_copy_label verbatim, so the user meets the same noun for the same object. Register is the guide's neutral tu-less product voice, sentence case, closed with a full stop like its sibling 'El archivo ya no está en esta ruta.' No placeholders, no plural, no punctuation drift. No finding.

observations.es: Ruta de la copia guardada copiada
observations.note: Byte-identical to the merge base and already passed in acd53e2cf056-r4-es, so it is not a regression and not counted as a finding here. Recording it only so the decision is visible: the trailing 'copiada' after a long noun phrase reads heavy. If a future pass wants a lighter announcement, 'Ruta de la copia guardada copiada' -> 'Ruta copiada de la copia guardada' would keep the meaning with a natural verb position. Do not change it in a merge commit; it is a copy edit that needs its own audit round.

limitations: The union is uncommitted in the audited checkout, so checkout_head 36b88a45fe is the PRE-merge head; both input_sha256 values are the working-tree bytes, not a commit. Re-derive them after the merge commit and re-bind the ledger.
read_public_copy refused both files ('differs from HEAD') - the strings were read from the working-tree files, not through the sanctioned reader.
No maxCells/maxChars hint is declared for any key in this namespace, so fit was judged by role and length only (longest es value, a tooltip, 56 characters).
ledger-check is red for all seven locales on this namespace until the merge commit re-binds the whole-file hashes; a green verdict here is about copy, not about release readiness.
One auditor and two reading passes; this is not two independent agents.
